verses.1: "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.2: Now the earth was unformed and void, and the darkness was upon the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters.
verses.3: Then God said, "Let there be light, " and there was light.
verses.4: God saw that the light was good, and he divided between the light and the darkness.
verses.5: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening, and there was morning - a day.
verses.6: Then God said, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it separate the waters from the waters".
verses.7: And God formed the expanse and separated the waters that were under the expanse from the waters that were above the expanse. And so it was.
verses.8: And God called the sky, "Evening. " And there was evening and there was morning - a second day.
verses.9: Then God said, "Let the waters under the earth gather together into one place, and let the dry land appear. " And it was so.
verses.10: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering of the waters he called Waters. And God saw that it was good.
verses.11: Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth grass, herbs yielding their kind on the earth, trees yielding their kind on the earth " And so it was.
verses.12: Then the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed according to their kind, and trees yielding fruit in their own kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.13: And there was evening and there was morning - the third day.
verses.14: Then God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament to separate the day from the night; let them be for signs, seasons, days and years.
verses.15: They were to be lights in the universe to illuminate the earth. And so it was.
verses.16: And God made the two great lights, the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night, and the stars.
verses.17: God put them in the sky to give light on the earth.
verses.18: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.19: And there was evening and there was morning - the fourth day.
verses.20: Then God said, "Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let swarms of birds swarm on the earth".
verses.21: So God made the great sea creatures and all kinds of living creatures that move in the water, and every kind of fruitful creature that moves, and God saw that it was good.
verses.22: God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the waters under the heaven and subdue the earth".
verses.23: And there was evening and there was morning - a fifth day.
verses.24: Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds - animals, reptiles and birds of the air, each with its own kind. " And it was so.
verses.25: So God made animals of the earth according to their kinds, and cattle according to their kinds, and every creeping thing of the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.26: Then God said, "Let us make man in our image, according to our likeness; and let them rule over the fish of the sea, over birds, over cattle, over the whole earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth".
verses.27: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him. Male and female he created them.
verses.28: And God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it; take possession of the fish of the sea, of the creeping things on the earth, and of every living thing that creeps on the earth".
verses.29: Then God said, "I have given you every green plant on the earth and every tree with fruit in it to be your food.
verses.30: To every living creature on earth, to everything that crawls on the ground and to everything that has life in it, I give every green plant for food. " And it was so.
verses.31: And God saw everything he had made and, look! it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
